Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See UI/UX issue

What should happen?

## Actual Behavior
What actually happens?

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to demonstrate the issue.
